people.name: Anathoth
people.line: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.

people.name: Hanamel
people.line: Jeremiah's cousin, from whom he bought a field.

translations.web: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
translations.bsb: So I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and I weighed out seventeen shekels of silver.
translations.kjv: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
translations.asv: And I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel mine uncle's son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
